operations.description:
Delete a dataset.

Delete-time dependency validation is enforced. A dataset cannot be deleted while one or more jobs
still reference it as an input or output through `JobProperties.inputs` or `JobProperties.outputs`
(via `JobDataset.dataset`). If any consuming job exists, the delete is rejected with the
`ResourceDeleteHasActiveConsumers` error (code `ARB-RP-228`) and the dataset is not deleted. The error reports the total
number of consumers and returns links to the consuming jobs, each with the property path of the reference.

Required steps before deleting a dataset:
1. Identify every job whose `properties.inputs` or `properties.outputs` reference this dataset.
2. For each consuming job, either update it to remove the reference to this dataset or delete the job
(and, where applicable, the pipeline that contains it).
3. Once no job references this dataset, retry this delete request.
operations.name: Microsoft.ResourceBuilder/workspaces/datasets/delete

operations.description:
Delete a workspace.

Deleting a workspace cascades to all child resources (datasets, data connections, pipelines, jobs,
and runs), which are removed as part of the ARM delete. A workspace is not subject to active-consumer
dependency validation, so this delete is not blocked by references between its child resources.
operations.name: Microsoft.ResourceBuilder/workspaces/delete

operations.description:
Delete a job.

Delete-time dependency validation is enforced. A job cannot be deleted while its parent pipeline
still references it by name through `PipelineProperties.activities[].job` (a `ReferencePipelineJob`).
If the parent pipeline references this job, the delete is rejected with the
`ResourceDeleteHasActiveConsumers` error (code `ARB-RP-228`) and the job is not deleted. The error reports the consuming
pipeline and the property path of the reference.

Required steps before deleting a job:
1. Update the parent pipeline to remove the activity that references this job, or delete the pipeline.
2. Once no pipeline activity references this job, retry this delete request.
operations.name: Microsoft.ResourceBuilder/workspaces/pipelines/jobs/delete

operations.description:
Delete a data connection.

Delete-time dependency validation is enforced. A data connection cannot be deleted while one or
more datasets in the same workspace still reference it through `DatasetProperties.connection.id`.
If any consuming dataset exists, the delete is rejected with the `ResourceDeleteHasActiveConsumers`
error (code `ARB-RP-228`) and the data connection is not deleted. The error reports the total number of consumers and
returns links to the consuming datasets, each with the property path of the reference.

Required steps before deleting a data connection:
1. Identify every dataset in the workspace whose `properties.connection.id` references this data connection.
2. For each consuming dataset, either update it to reference a different data connection (detach)
or delete the dataset.
3. Once no dataset references this data connection, retry this delete request.
operations.name: Microsoft.ResourceBuilder/workspaces/dataConnections/delete
